author: smarties2437
body: Hi my name is smarties2437. I've been playing for 2+ years. I love playing on the server because of it's uniqueness. About 1 year ago I was banned from the server For Regen: hacking. I don't know what that means but I do think I know why I got banned. When I got banned I had a mod on called Assassin's Creed Parkour Mod which allows you to stick to walls and do other stuff. I forgot to take it off when I got on to multiplayer. Heck I didn't even know it would work in multiplayer. I found out on accident. After that I used it a couple of times. I was caught or I don't really know what happened but I assume that was why I was Banned. Since then I uninstalled the mod ( It was kind of lame in single player). I would love it if you would allow me to play on the server because I am sorry that I was moded. Plz Allow me back on to the best server in the world
